3. The defendant No.1 contested the suit by filing a written statement denying all the material allegations made in the plaint, stating, inter alia, that the defendants father Sultan Mahmud had been living at Maijdee town and at that time he became ill in the first part of March, 1971; that the plaintiff No. 1 in collusion with his maternal uncle Golam Rabbani showing his father as vendor and by false personification created a forged deed dated 18-5-1971 and that in fact, Sultan Mahmud had no necessity to sell 6.54 acres of land at consideration of Taka 2500. It is further stated that the defendant No.1 came to know about the said kabala from plaintiff No. 1 and his maternal uncle on 17-11-1974, the defendant obtained certified copy on 22-1-1974 and definitely came to know about the said kabala Thereafter the defendant filed the Title Suit No. 45 of 1974, praying for a decree of declaration that the said kabala is not binding upon him. In the said suit, plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 were defendant Nos. 1 and 2. In the said suit the summons were duly served upon the defendant and the defendant contested the suit by filing written statement by engaging a senior Advocate. In the meantime, the uncle of the defendant No. 1 drafted a solenama by late Advocate Sekandar Mia. The defendant No.1 for himself and for his mother signed the solenama and gave deposition in the Court in support of the solenama. The parties have been possessing their respective share as per Shariat, Solenama is genuine and, as such, the suit of the plaintiff is liable to be dismissed. 

 10. On the other hand, the case of the defendants is that grandson and son's wife of Sultan Mahmud collusively obtained the deed dated 8-5- 1971 which is forged and fraudulent and possession of the land was not delivered on the basis of that deed. The further contention of the defendants opposite parties is that the defendant as plaintiff filed TS No. 115 of 1974 cancelling sale deed dated 8-5- 1971 and that the Suit was compromised on the basis solenama on 9-8-1997 which is genuine. 

 11. Both the parties adduced evidence on the trial Court and the trial Court on consideration of the evidence on record it appears that the summons of Title Suit No. 115 of 1974 was served upon the defendant and suit was decreed on the basis of solenama on 9-8-1997. It further appears that the deed dated 8-5-1971 is collusive and the land of the deed in question was not delivered upon the plaintiffs and the sole decree dated 9-8-1997 is genuine.
